newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares gain, Unibanka well traded.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares gain, Unibanka well traded.

text.p: The Latvian stock exchange saw active trade on Tuesday with most shares gaining and leading bank Unibanka in the spotlight as a large amount of business was done in its stocks.
Total market trade came to 244,000 lats and the Rietumu Bank Rietumu 16 index rose 0.60 percent to 219.55.
Unibanka, which on Monday said it doubled its 1996 profits to 5.978 million lats, turned over 104,100 lats of shares as it crept higher to 4.51 lats from 4.50.
The shares had a bull run last week although demand today remained high at 318,400 shares.

Valmiera Glassfibre was also active again on trade of 57,600 lats and it rose to 2.31 lats from 2.24 lats. The share is rapidly regaining most of the ground it lost at the end of last week, when it slumped after sharp gains.
These two stocks overshadowed what was a quiet day for the rest of the market.
Riga Transport Fleet turned over 16,500 lats of shares and was stable at 1.70 lats while Staburadze, also on the official list, traded 6,900 lats and slipped to 2.85 lats from 2.94 lats.
